text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: rate-limit-surge on inference-api-prod - high error rate and 5xx spike. P50 latency rising. Escalation-> oncall:sre.

anna: I’m on it. seeing a bunch of 429s from the batching service, started 10:12 UTC.

jordan: grabbing logs from edge and batch router. any customer reports yet?

maya: product-side: one enterprise client reported degraded embeddings. pinged account team.

anna: quick triage: rate limiter went into emergency backoff due to rapid short bursts from a new job type. hit global token quota and started rejecting.

ryan: can we temporary lift quota for critical tiers?

anna: yes, doing a scoped increase for enterprise tier now. running: `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/quotas/adjust -d '{"tier":"enterprise","delta":200}'` (sanitized).

incident-bot: Bot note: quota change applied by anna at 10:18 UTC.

jordan: pushed a small routing tweak to send retryable traffic to a secondary pool to reduce pressure on the primary. `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/router ROUTE_OVERRIDE=secondary-pool`

lin: logs show adaptive-batcher config recently rolled out at 09:55 - higher aggressiveness for small requests. sample log: `batcher: strategy=adaptive threshold=12 -> enqueue_delay=1ms` - could be causing bursts.

anna: rollback candidate: revert adaptive-batcher config to previous stable. I can do a canary rollback to 10% first.

maya: customer comms: holding message drafted, will wait until mitigation confirmed.

ryan: mitigation confirmed: 429 rate dropping, p50 latency back to baseline. thanks.

anna: handing off to night oncall for post-incident writeup and RCA. @jordan will own the initial timeline + logs, @lin will investigate config rollout correlation, @maya will finalize customer impact note.

jordan: starting a timeline doc in /shared/incidents/1723456789-rate-limit-draft.md - will include timestamps, command outputs, and log snippets.

lin: immediate action items: 1) revert aggressive adaptive-batcher flag (done canary), 2) add circuit-breaker on batcher, 3) validation gate for rollout to ensure token-quota checks. I’ll put PRs up.

maya: scheduling postmortem sync tomorrow 15:00 UTC. who should attend? ops, eng-runtime, product, sde on the batching rollout.

anna: please include cost/throughput impact in the RCA - we had to route to secondary pool which increased per-token cost ~8%.

jordan: RCA draft checklist: timeline, contributing factors (batcher rollout + quota thresholds + missing rollout gate), scope of impact (embeddings for 3 customers), mitigations (quota bump, routing, rollback), permanent remediation, owners, and review notes.

lin: target to open PRs for the three remediation items by EOD tomorrow.

maya: I’ll prep a short customer-facing summary for the three affected accounts; want to present during the sync.

anna: sign-off plan: RCA draft in repo -> peer review by eng-runtime (jordan/lin) -> product review (maya) -> exec sign-off (anna). set sign-off deadline in thread.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: postmortem-sync tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

jordan: thanks team. adding action-item tracker to the doc and assigning owners. will ping once initial RCA draft is ready for review. :thumbsup:
